edges.reason: Constructor writes msg.sender (_msgSender()) into _owner, making the caller the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier requires _owner == _msgSender() before enableTrading executes.
onlyOwner gate protects updateMaxTxnAmount from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects updateMaxWalletAmount from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects updateBuyFees from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects updateSellFees from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects excludeFromMaxTransaction from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects excludeFromFees from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects setAutoLPBurnSettings from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects transferOwnership from non-owner callers.
onlyOwner gate protects renounceOwnership from non-owner callers.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime, seeding timestamp-dependent LP burn logic.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger auto burn.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens enforces a cooldown using block.timestamp against lastManualLpBurnTime.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the add-liquidity deadline to the router.
_transfer uses tx.origin as the key of _holderLastTransferTimestamp to limit one purchase per block, allowing relayed/bot abuse.
The per-origin transfer timestamp mapping is read and written during transfers.
tradingActive gates whether non-excluded accounts may transfer tokens.
limitsInEffect decides whether max transaction and max wallet checks run.
The swapping flag suppresses recursive swapBack and LP burn during a transfer.
The swapping flag is checked/set around the swapBack external interaction path.
maxTransactionAmount bounds the transferred amount on buys and sells.
maxWallet bounds the recipient balance on buys and plain transfers.
_isExcludedFromFees bypasses trading gate, fee logic and LP burn checks.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount bypasses the max transaction and max wallet limits.
automatedMarketMakerPairs classifies a transfer as a buy or sell and selects the fee branch.
lpBurnFrequency is added to lastLpBurnTime when evaluating the auto burn condition.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates the last burn timestamp slot.
_transfer invokes swapBack while token balances are being moved, widening the reentrancy surface.
_transfer can invoke autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens, which makes an external pair.sync() call.
_transfer computes fee amounts with mul/div and accumulates per-category token counters.
swapBack converts tokens to ETH through swapTokensForEth.
swapBack adds liquidity through addLiquidity when liquidity tokens are available.
swapBack performs an uncontrolled low-level ETH transfer to devWallet.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH transfer of the whole remaining balance to marketingWallet.
swapTokensForEth calls the router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens entry point.
addLiquidity calls the router addLiquidityETH entry point with ETH value.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens triggers an external pair.sync() call on the AMM pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens triggers an external pair.sync() call on the AMM pair.
devWallet state variable is the recipient of the low-level value call, allowing it to be swapped for an attacker-controlled contract by the owner.
marketingWallet state variable is the recipient of the low-level value call in swapBack.
The devWallet low-level call forwards ETH with all gas, allowing the recipient to re-enter _transfer/swapBack before the transfer completes.
The marketingWallet low-level call forwards ETH with all gas, allowing the recipient to re-enter _transfer/swapBack.
Recipient parameter feeds the limit checks and final super._transfer call.
Amount parameter drives limit comparisons, fee computation and final transfer amount.
New amount parameter is bounded and stored as swapTokensAtAmount.
New amount parameter is scaled and stored as maxTransactionAmount.
New amount parameter is scaled and stored as maxWallet.
Percent parameter is capped and used to compute the manual burn amount.
Cached contract balance determines the swap and liquidity amounts inside swapBack.
Computed fees are used for the fee transfer and to reduce the transferred amount.
Sender parameter determines fee applicability, exclusion checks and limit branch selection.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter has no independent security semantics and is consumed entirely by _transfer's limit and transfer logic.
The amount parameter is a local input to _transfer's arithmetic and limit checks, so it merges into that function.
The sender parameter only feeds _transfer's exclusion, limit and fee decisions.
The fees local is produced by the fee arithmetic operation in _transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The parameter is only validated and written into swapTokensAtAmount by that setter.
The parameter is only scaled and stored into maxTransactionAmount by that setter.
The parameter is only scaled and stored into maxWallet by that setter.
The percent parameter is bounded and used solely for the burn calculation in that function.
The cached balance local has no meaning outside the swapBack swap-and-liquify routine.
